Generate a column name guaranteed not to collide with existing

Source: R/window.R
unique_temp_name.Rd

Appends an incrementing integer suffix to base until the candidate name is not already present in existing. The very first candidate tried is the bare base itself (no suffix); collisions start the suffix at 1. Shared by every part of the package that needs a synthetic temp column name: slice_min()/slice_max()'s computed order_by column (R/slice.R, via unique_slice_order_name()), and the window decomposition's ..win*../..winarg*.. temp columns below.

Usage

unique_temp_name(base, existing)

Arguments

base

Character scalar, the desired base name (e.g. "..win..")

existing

Character vector of names already in use

Value

A character scalar not in existing
